answer: The gale schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the lotus checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Someone wanting 23 effective identities must lock that capital for 58 epochs and keep it locked through every umber audit. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 58 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. That is 4 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
